title: 52,000 Yuan upon Signing! Robot Unicorn Yushu Technology Advances to the Sci-Tech Innovation Board, Estimated Issue Price Exceeds 100 Yuan
excerpt: On August 5, the leading humanoid robot company in China, Autonavi Technology, officially launched the preliminary inquiry for its IPO on the Sci-Tech Innovatio
content_html:
On August 5, the leading humanoid robot company in China, Autonavi Technology, officially launched the preliminary inquiry for its IPO on the Sci-Tech Innovation Board, with the time period from 9:30 to 15:00 on the same day. The sponsor and lead underwriter simultaneously conducted checks on offline investors, and investors participating in the strategic placement made payments for their subscription funds. The company will determine the final issue price, valid bidders, and the number of shares they can subscribe on August 6, and will open online and offline subscriptions on August 10, with the payment deadline set for August 12.

In terms of capital issuance data, Autonavi Technology plans to issue 40.4464 million new shares, accounting for 10% of the total share capital after the issue (404 million shares), with a planned fundraising amount of 4.202 billion yuan. The market generally expects the company's IPO valuation to exceed 40 billion yuan. According to the estimated valuation and the 500-share subscription unit of the Sci-Tech Innovation Board, the estimated issue price of Autonavi Technology is about 104 yuan per share, corresponding to a subscription amount of approximately 52,000 yuan per lot. The actual issue price is still to be finally determined by market inquiries.

As the "first stock of humanoid robots in A-shares," Autonavi Technology's listing marks the comprehensive acceleration of the capitalization process of embodied intelligence and the robot industry chain. More than 4 billion yuan in fundraising will greatly strengthen its core competitiveness in robot body R&D, breakthroughs in embodied intelligence large models, and capacity building, leading the domestic embodied intelligence sector into a new stage of scale and commercialization.

content_html_zh:
8月5日，国内仿人机器人龙头企业高德科技在科创板正式启动IPO预问询，时间为当日9:30至15:00。 保荐机构和主承销商同步对线下投资者进行核查，参与战略配售的投资者缴纳了认购资金。 公司将于8月6日确定最终发行价格、有效投标人及可认购数量，并于8月10日开启线上线下申购，缴款截止日期为8月12日。

发行数据方面，高德科技拟发行4044.64万股新股，占发行后总股本（4.04亿股）的10%，计划募资金额42.02亿元。 市场普遍预计该公司IPO估值将突破400亿元。 根据预估估值及科创板500股申购单位，高德科技预估发行价约为104元/股，对应申购金额约为每手5.2万元。 实际发行价格仍有待市场询价最终确定。

作为“A股人形机器人第一股”，高德科技的上市标志着体身智能及机器人产业链资本化进程全面加速。 超过40亿元的募资将极大增强其在机器人本体研发、具身智能大模型突破、能力建设等方面的核心竞争力，引领国内具身智能领域进入规模化和商业化的新阶段。
